import os
os.makedirs(os.path.dirname(p),exist_ok=True)
source='''def transform(grid):\n    def expand_row(row):\n        return list(reversed(row)) + list(row)\n\n    rows = list(grid)\n    mirrored_rows = list(reversed(rows))\n    return [expand_row(row) for row in mirrored_rows + rows + mirrored_rows]\n'''
with open(p,'w') as f: f.write(source)
ns={}
exec(compile(source,p,'exec'),ns)
transform=ns['transform']
test=[[3,8],[0,1],[1,1],[5,3],[1,8]]
out=transform(test)
print(out)
# verify demo2 formula, using observed rows
